_comment: Which image variants exist. Read by both images.go (embedded, for srcset) and frontend/scripts/images.js (for generation), so the widths that get written into the page and the widths that get generated cannot drift apart.
_formatNote: AVIF over WebP after measuring these actual images: same size or smaller at matched accuracy, and AOMedia rather than Google. Support is Chrome 85+, Firefox 93+, Safari 16.4+, Edge 121+. JPEG was the other candidate and costs about 45% more bytes here.
